scene: The gondola sways gently as soapy suds bubble outside the glass.
beats: You wipe the glass just as a silver weather-kite guides the gondola into the dock. The doors hiss open to Rainmaker Rooftops.
You crank the stubborn gear until it clicks, easing the gondola against rain barrels. The doors rattle open onto the misty rooftop.
The foam fizzes like mint soda on your tongue! The floor bumps gently against cloud tanks, and the cabin doors slide wide open.
picture: Side view inside the narrow metal gondola. On the far left, a fogged oval window pane looks out on receding telescopes. At centre-left, the player in burnt-orange jacket, beanie, and telescope rests his prosthetic leg. In the centre, a brass winch clacks. On the right, a turquoise glowing wash-bucket sits near passenger benches.
shown: a fogged oval window pane on the far left
a mechanical winch clacking noisily in the centre
a soapy bucket glowing bright turquoise on the right

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the gondola glides past, dodging a stray raindrop. At the terminus, you hop aboard the bridge crawler, arriving just as Gear Bridge turns into view.

variants.scene: The cosy cable car creaks softly while you hum {tune}.
beats: A quick swipe clears the pane just as a silver weather-kite leads the car safely into port. The doors hiss wide.
You heave the brass winch until the gears click, settling the car against rooftop rain barrels. The doors rattle open.
The bright lather sparkles like sweet peppermint soda! With a soft bump against mist tanks, the cabin doors slide apart.
variants.ride_on: You sit tight as the platform slips away, ducking a cold raindrop. At the final station you board the bridge crawler, rolling right up to Gear Bridge.

variants.scene: Warm lights hum overhead as frothy suds splash against the chilly window.
beats: Your sleeve rubs a circle clear as a shimmering weather-kite steers you toward the landing. The passenger doors hiss open.
You haul on the heavy spool until it catches, bringing the gondola gently beside rainwater barrels. The doors rattle open.
A tiny dab tastes just like fizzy mint candy! The floor thuds lightly beside tall cloud reservoirs, and the doors slide open.
variants.ride_on: You keep your seat as the stop glides by, missing a splash of rain. At the terminus you switch to the bridge crawler, arriving just as Gear Bridge appears.

variants.scene: Neon suds shine on the floorboards inside the gently swaying cabin.
beats: You sweep away the mist as a sleek weather-kite guides the craft into the station dock. The doors hiss open.
You turn the squeaking handle until it locks, parking the cabin right next to wooden rain barrels. The doors rattle open.
The glowing lather tickles your tongue like cool peppermint! The car nudges against big cloud tanks, and the doors slide open.
variants.ride_on: You remain aboard while the stop drifts past, avoiding a stray raindrop. Switching to the bridge crawler at the line's end, you pull in beside Gear Bridge.
